text:
Arun: Grove7b model artifact uploaded to dev-staging. Can eng-ml pick up a sanity + basic correctness pass?
Maya: on it. I'll run the minimal prompt set and tokenization checks. ETA 20m
Liam: FYI runtime changes for KV cache landed earlier, watch for OOMs on seq len 4096
Sofia: I'll run bias/safety quick-rejects and the smoke evals from our /eng-ml sanity prompt set
Arun: Priority checks: 1) tokenization mismatch 2) generation coherence on 8 targeted prompts 3) stop-token adherence 4) memory/latency baseline 5) regression vs master-4b
Maya: running curl test now:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"grove7b","input":"Summarize: The company released..."}' https://dev.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```
Maya: got ~2.1s p95 for 256 tokens, passing our latency baseline
Liam: saw a single OOM during batch=16, switching to batch=8 for now and re-running
Sofia: Safety quick-check: refuses to provide personal data in a PII prompt, passes the quick filters
Arun: can we add a quick quantization smoke? try int8-quant profile q2a and compare logits for a deterministic prompt
Maya: int8 run: top-1 matches fp16 for 6/8 prompts, two divergence cases — collecting examples
Maya: examples:
- prompt: "Translate to Spanish: The quick brown fox"
  fp16: "El rápido zorro marrón"
  int8: "El zorro marrón rapido"  (word order shift)
Liam: Likely tokenizer normalization difference, filing ticket ENG-ML-452 to track tokenization/normalization diff
Arun: ok create PR with checklist and label `model-onboard/grove7b`; if regressions >2 prompts, hold rollout
Sofia: marking as `devstg/blocked` until int8 anomalies investigated :eyes:
deploy-bot: Model artifact grove7b@sha256:abc123 uploaded to dev-staging by arun
Maya: attaching perf logs and sample outputs in the ticket (links in the ticket thread)
Arun: thanks — we'll reconvene after fixes. ping @Maya @Sofia when ready
